item.title: Institutional XRP Yield Products Coming as Doppler Finance Partners With SBI Ripple Asia
item.description: In an interesting development, leading XRPL project Doppler Finance has entered into a strategic partnership with SBI Ripple Asia. Per a statement released today, the collaboration will focus on developing institutional-grade XRP yield products and advancing the tokenization of real-world assets (RWAs) on the XRP Ledger (XRPL).Visit Website

item.title: Curved or Straight? Veteran Peter Brandt Responds as the Bitcoin Banana Slip Kicks In
item.description: Veteran trader Peter Brandt has sparked another round of debate in the crypto community with his Bitcoin Banana chart post. Notably, the Banana chart has been Brandt’s long-standing Bitcoin outlook.Visit Website

item.title: Rich Dad Poor Dad Author Says Buying Bitcoin Is One Way to Get Richer as Global Economy Crashes
item.description: Amid global economic uncertainties, "Rich Dad Poor Dad" author Robert Kiyosaki has identified Bitcoin as one way investors could get richer. Despite the sustained pressure faced by the crypto market in recent times, as the global crypto market cap loses more than $1.92 trillion in total value over three months, Robert Kiyosaki continues to argue that Bitcoin presents an opportunity to build wealth during economic turmoil.Visit Website

item.title: Bhutan to Allocate 10,000 Bitcoin for Development of Gelephu Mindfulness City
item.description: Bhutan has announced plans to allocate 10,000 Bitcoin from its national reserves to support the development of Gelephu Mindfulness City (GMC). Located in southern Bhutan near the town of Gelephu, the project was conceived as a response to the steady outflow of young Bhutanese seeking employment abroad.Visit Website

item.title: Bitcoin Miner Hut 8 Secures $7B Google-Backed AI Data Center Lease
item.description: Bitcoin miner Hut 8 has landed one of the largest infrastructure deals ever signed by a Bitcoin company. In particular, Hut 8 has secured a 15-year, $7 billion lease to deliver large-scale AI data center capacity at its River Bend campus in Louisiana.Visit Website

item.title: The Last Time This Happened, XRP Spiked 850%: Details
item.description: XRP has spent nearly 70 days below the pivotal 50-week SMA, with historical data triggering bullish expectations for the future. The broader crypto market has continued to face bearish pressure since early October, with the global crypto market cap losing over $1.38 trillion worth of value within this period.Visit Website

item.title: Pundit Says People Laughing at XRP Will ‘End Up Crying for Life’
item.description: Widely followed XRP community commentator UnknowDLT has issued a stern warning to critics who continue to dismiss XRP’s long-term potential. In a recent post on X, he argued that XRP’s role in global finance was “planned more than a decade ago”.Visit Website

item.title: Analyst Says You Won’t Be Able to Buy XRP Again if You Plan to Sell Now and Buy Back Later
item.description: A market commentator has suggested that investors planning to sell XRP and buy back later at lower prices may not be able to purchase the token again. XRP has collapsed with the rest of the crypto market, leading to losses for investors who held past the $3.66 peak in July 2025.Visit Website

item.title: Brandt Says Love It or Not, You Need to Deal with XRP Bearish Structure

As the global crypto market loses over $1.3 trillion over a three-month period, XRP has not been spared in the bloodbath.Visit Website

item.title: Early Shiba Inu Top Investor Who Turned $13K Into $9B Moves 469B SHIB to OKX
item.description: An early Shiba Inu whale who accumulated 103 trillion SHIB in 2020 has resurfaced, transferring 469 billion SHIB to OKX. Blockchain analyst EmberCN first drew public attention to the transaction, which occurred over the past day.Visit Website
